Maria Chen: Heads-up — Nebula onboarding: token burn spiked ~3x after rolling semantic search into prod. Need a lean QBR slide with root causes, 30d projection, and three tangible asks (credits + ops + enablement). Can someone own the data?
Samir Rao: Ill take route-level telemetry and model breakdowns. Pulling live export now.
Ana Gomez: Ill do forecast scenarios (steady, ramp, runaway) and calculate run-rate impact on renewal. What credits/retainer are on file?
Lena Park: Ill draft recommended controls: short-term soft-throttle, switch to emb-lite model during spikes, and an SDK batching example. Also capture their feedback re: embedding latency and occasional 5xxs.
Maria Chen: They reported embedding p95 latency ~480ms at peak and intermittent errors (timeout 504). Flagging product on latency regression.
Samir Rao: Quick SQL I ran to verify:
```sql
SELECT route, model_variant, SUM(tokens) tokens, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) p95_latency
FROM usage
WHERE account='nebula' AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY route, model_variant;
```
Samir Rao: Findings: embeddings.default = 78% tokens, emb-large p95 490ms, emb-quant-v2 used only 2% of calls. Chat routes negligible.
Ana Gomez: Preliminary forecasts:
- steady: +18% spend next 30d
- ramp: +52% next 30d
- runaway: +130% next 30d (if activity doubles and current model stays)
Ive attached scenario CSV to the account doc (nebula_forecast_v2.csv) and included amortized impact on renewal ARR.
Maria Chen: Suggested QBR asks: 1) 5k one-time credit buffer (to avoid-ledger churn), 2) short-term soft-limit on heavy embed route (configurable), 3) follow-up enablement session with SDK batching and dedupe.
Lena Park: Example throttle policy I propose to include in the deck:
```json
{"route":"embeddings","limit_per_min":250000,"fallback":"emb-lite-v1","alert_on":"+10%_hour"}
```
Samir Rao: Ill open a support ticket linking the route CSV and propose the above throttle. Also adding runbook steps for automated fallback to emb-lite when p95 > 350ms.
Ana Gomez: For the retainer ask: modeling shows 5k credits covers ~40 days under ramp scenario; I recommend 5k as conservative ask and we can offer a 30% amortization for renewal negotiation.
qbr-bot: Reminder: QBR slides due Thu 09:00 PST in #qbr-drafts.
Maria Chen: Great. @Samir can you confirm the exact CSV filename and push to the ticket? @Lena please attach the SDK snippet and a short checklist for engs.
Samir Rao: Done. Ticket #CS-9876 created and CSV attached (nebula_route_tokens_30d.csv).
Lena Park: SDK batching snippet + dedupe heuristics uploaded to the shared enablement doc. I'll also schedule a 20m follow-up with their engineers Tues 11:00 PT.
Maria Chen: Perfect — I'll consolidate into the QBR deck and add the product latency ticket link. Closing this thread unless anything else comes up. Thanks team!
